methodologies.name: 2x2 Orthogonal Causal-Associative Confounded SCM
methodologies.purpose: Separate causal intervention direction T from observational association direction S under known backdoor graph Z->X, Z->Y, X->Y.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: tau = E[Y|do(X=1)] - E[Y|do(X=0)]; delta_obs = tau - k*gap with |k*gap| > |tau|.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Confounding shortcut vs causal identification; exposing constant yes/no biases.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Succeeded in exposing near-constant activation/decline biases; original fixed-k version had larger |delta_obs| in aligned cells.
methodologies.final_disposition: Modified into matched-strength (M06) and eventually CF-TP1 feasible role-swap SCM (M18).

methodologies.name: CNI-Style Multinomial Processing Tree (C, A, B)
methodologies.purpose: Decompose binary action probabilities into causal sensitivity C, conditional association A, and residual action preference B.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: P(act=1|T,S) = C*T + (1-C)[A*S + (1-A)*B], fitted by simplex EM with parametric bootstrap deviance.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Aggregate conflict penalty wA = (1-C)A confounds loss of C with rise in A.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Exposed symmetric logistic observational equivalence in simulation and failed additivity restriction (-43.75 pp residual) on Cohort 005 F16.
methodologies.final_disposition: Abandoned for latent-route reporting from Cohort 005 onward; retained only for conceptual cue-crossing motivation.

methodologies.name: Single-Fence JSON Sensitivity vs Strict Scoring
methodologies.purpose: Quantify how Markdown ```json fencing affects validity without granting credit for prose or malformed schemas.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Exact JSON parse on raw string (strict) vs unwrapping a single complete Markdown code fence (sensitivity).
methodologies.problem_addressed: 100% of early Qwen 3B/7B completions wrapped valid JSON in Markdown fences, causing 0/64 strict floors.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Cleanly separated formatting habit from decision content in Cohorts 001-012, but failed when Cohort 013 appended explanatory prose after fences.
methodologies.final_disposition: Superseded in Cohort 014+ by strict one-key bare JSON instructions and 48/64-token caps (M08).

methodologies.name: Formula-Given Arithmetic Control & Estimate-Sign Split
methodologies.purpose: Hold numeric stratum table fixed while supplying explicit backdoor arithmetic formula; score sign(ate_estimate) separately from activate.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: score = 0.5*((r[0,1]-r[0,0]) + (r[1,1]-r[1,0])); I(ate_estimate > 0) vs explicit activate in {0,1}.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Disentangle causal formula selection from arithmetic execution and action-field commitment.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Revealed dramatic estimate-action dissociation (F16 61/64 signs vs 32/64 actions in 002) and replicated 3B Q4 sign loss (-31.25 pp in 007).
methodologies.final_disposition: Modified into matched noncausal scorecards in Cohorts 018, 019, 023, 024, 028, and 029.

methodologies.name: Supplied-Rate Source Selection & Interleaved Order Crossover
methodologies.purpose: Supply pre-computed randomized and historical rates directly and cross physical line order within-session using opaque twin IDs.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Within-family paired difference Acc(historical_first) - Acc(randomized_first) with family-cluster bootstrap.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Eliminate stratum arithmetic and remove cross-session timing confounds in presentation-order testing.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Isolated reproducible -21.9 to -28.1 pp F16 order shift in 3B and later +62.5 pp Q4 order shift in 7B.
methodologies.final_disposition: Retained and refined across Cohorts 011-024 and 029.

methodologies.name: Matched Observational-Strength SCM Generator
methodologies.purpose: Adjust treatment assignment propensity by alignment cell so historical contrast |delta_obs| = m is identical in aligned and conflict items.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Set confounding gap = m - e (aligned) and m + e (conflict), propensity k = confounding_gap / severity_gap.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Eliminate aligned-vs-conflict observational magnitude asymmetry present in M01.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Equalized historical magnitudes exactly, but because |tau| = e in [0.06,0.12) < m in [0.38,0.46), inadvertently created a 100%-accurate source-blind smaller-gap heuristic.
methodologies.final_disposition: Superseded after retrospective shortcut discovery by graph-switch (M15) and CF-TP1 feasible role-swap (M18).

methodologies.name: Predeclared Reference Competence Gates
methodologies.purpose: Require higher-precision F16 arm to clear validity, overall, and per-order conflict/control thresholds before running quantized arms.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Fixed integer cutoffs frozen in run plan before inference (e.g., >=90% valid, >=56.25% conflict per order).
methodologies.problem_addressed: Prevent misinterpreting floor-level noise or default biases as quantization preservation or selective damage.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Prevented wasteful quantization sweeps in 004, 012, 014, 018, 019, 026, 027, 028; limitation: uncalibrated pass in 015 (89 vs 88) did not guarantee stability in 016.
methodologies.final_disposition: Retained throughout development; Cohort 029 shifted to an ungated single-deployment methodological case study.

methodologies.name: Strict Bare-Token / One-Key JSON Response Contract
methodologies.purpose: Explicitly forbid Markdown fences and explanations, show both exact allowed literals, and cap max_tokens tightly (48 or 64).
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Strict parser with duplicate-key hook, integer type check (rejecting booleans/floats), and finish_reason=='stop'.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Eliminate Cohort 013 trailing-prose invalidations and parser sensitivity forks.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Achieved 100% strict validity across Cohorts 014-023, 027, 029 (exception: Llama Q4 448 control truncations in 024 and Llama v2 trailing period in 026).
methodologies.final_disposition: Retained as canonical scoring standard through final release.

methodologies.name: Gaussian-Copula Family-Cluster Power Simulation
methodologies.purpose: Simulate correlated binary pair discordance within SCM families before freezing confirmatory sample size.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: 100,000 Monte Carlo replicates of paired binary differences with rho=0.50, discordance=0.70-0.90, two-sided family t-test.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Avoid underpowered pilots or treating correlated prompts within a family as independent N.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Powered Cohort 016 (N=96 families, 80.7% power for 20 pp effect) before collection.
methodologies.final_disposition: Supplemented in Cohort 029 by stratified Welch-Satterthwaite coverage calibration (M19).

methodologies.name: Signal Detection Theory (d', Criterion) & Graded Strengths
methodologies.purpose: Separate discrimination of beneficial vs harmful interventions from baseline activation tendency.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: d' = Phi^-1(H) - Phi^-1(F), c = -0.5*[Phi^-1(H) + Phi^-1(F)] with half-count boundary correction on valid responses.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Balanced accuracy of 50% conceals whether a model guesses randomly or activates 100% of the time.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Exposed negative/zero d' paired with extreme negative criterion (activation bias) in Qwen causal tasks vs positive d' in noncausal controls.
methodologies.final_disposition: Retained as descriptive coordinates; two-point strength grid in 018 was insufficient for full psychometric curves.

methodologies.name: Within-World Token-Mapping & Option-Order Counterbalancing
methodologies.purpose: Cross semantic labels, neutral tokens (K/M, X=0/X=1), study names (A/B), and displayed option order on identical stems.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Semantic decoding (token XOR mapping) and metamorphic pair consistency checks.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Isolate superficial token/position habits from substantive evidence use.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Uncovered +25.8/+36.7 pp K/M reversal shifts in Qwen (019) and 256/256 first-option selection in Mistral F16 (024/025).
methodologies.final_disposition: Retained; crossed within-family in 023/024/027/028 and balanced across stratum slots in 029.

methodologies.name: Staged Component & Prompt-Guidance Decomposition
methodologies.purpose: Query single-pair number reading, direct source ID, governing-source selection, randomized-only, ordinary, and guided decisions separately.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Family-paired differences (e.g., Acc(rand_only) - Acc(two_source)) in stateless fresh contexts.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Test whether two-source failure comes from misreading numbers or failing to recognize randomized designs.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Demonstrated 100% governing-source selection (128/128) alongside 45.3% ordinary and guided action accuracy (58/128) in Qwen 7B F16.
methodologies.final_disposition: Retained as behavioral dissociation evidence, with explicit caveat that separate calls do not prove internal causal mediation.

methodologies.name: Matched Noncausal Scorecard & Harmful-Direction Controls
methodologies.purpose: Pair every causal prompt with an isomorphic noncausal primary-scorecard or weighted-sum task sharing numbers and target actions.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Direction-stratified control accuracy (>=75% in both beneficial and harmful directions) and causal-minus-control contrasts.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Prevent attributing general arithmetic, table-reading, or decline-avoidance errors to causal reasoning deficits.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Blocked premature causal-specificity claims in 018, 023, 024, 027, and anchored the primary contrast in 029.
methodologies.final_disposition: Retained as essential discriminant control through final manuscript.

methodologies.name: Retrospective Metamorphic & Information-Theoretic Archive Audit
methodologies.purpose: Reanalyze persisted raw JSONL across cohorts for option-reversal invariance, precision transitions, and plug-in mutual information.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: I(Response; Truth) and I(Response; Assoc | Truth) over {0, 1, invalid}; paired item transition matrices.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Synthesize 24 cohorts (>40,000 responses) without spending compute or conflating post hoc checks with confirmation.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Quantified Mistral's 6/128 option invariance, Qwen's 0.031-bit causal MI, and non-transfer of 016's Q4 order interaction to 024 (0 pp).
methodologies.final_disposition: Completed its audit role and formally bounded non-estimable methods.

methodologies.name: Exact-Rational Observationally Identical Graph-Switch Assay
methodologies.purpose: Construct binary (W,X,Y) joint distributions identical in Fractions for confounder (W->X,Y) and mediator (X->W->Y) with opposite do(X) signs, plus W->Z invariant control.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Exact Python fractions.Fraction verification: tau_conf = sum_w P(w)[P(Y=1|X=1,w)-P(Y=1|X=0,w)] < 0 < tau_med.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Eliminate observational table cues completely so only supplied causal structure determines the action.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Mathematically airtight (after fixing v1 Y-complement bug in 026 and option-order coupling in 027), but all tested 3B-8B F16 models scored 0/8 order-robust paired switch fidelity.
methodologies.final_disposition: Abandoned after Cohort 028 proved even calculator-assisted F16 models failed graph-to-rule selection.

methodologies.name: Structured Rule Selection + Allowlisted Deterministic Calculator Replay
methodologies.purpose: Model emits JSON {rule, score_x0, score_x1, action} (System B); pure function replays selected rule on public numbers with zero oracle access (System C).
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Primary gain mean_i(C_i - B_i) on causal raw tasks vs specificity contrast (C-B)_causal - (C-B)_control.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Test whether arithmetic errors alone masked graph-identification competence in Cohort 027.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Cleanly falsified the arithmetic-only bottleneck hypothesis: C rescued controls to 87.5%-100% while leaving causal accuracy near 50%.
methodologies.final_disposition: Completed in Cohort 028; motivated shift to identifiable study-provenance transport in Cohort 029.

methodologies.name: Durable Append-Only Journal, Lockfiles & Hourly/Branch Git Checkpoints
methodologies.purpose: Persist every dispatched request and raw response with fsync, SHA-256 digests, single-writer locks, and automated non-destructive Git checkpoints.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Intent -> dispatch -> base64-encoded raw response envelope bound to manifest SHA-256.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Prevent silent replacement of failed/wrong attempts, survive multi-hour CPU pauses/shutdowns, and guarantee byte-identical offline replay.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Enabled zero-loss recovery across Cohort 024 budget pauses, Cohort 028 shutdown, and 4,096/4,096 verified envelopes in Cohort 029.

methodologies.name: CF-TP1 Feasible Role-Swap & Target-Population Standardization
methodologies.purpose: Construct paired 2x2x2 tables L and R that are simultaneously realizable under latent U confounding in BOTH role assignments, crossed with two target stratum mixtures w0, w1.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: Latent surface (2h-r, 3r-2h) in (0,1)^8 for both roles; tau_k = w_k*delta_1 + (1-w_k)*delta_0; pair fidelity F_pair = I_0 * I_1.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Break Cohort 016's magnitude-gap shortcut and distinguish direction-correct switches from constant bias or random flipping.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Zero public/private oracle mismatches across 4,096 prompts; exposed 995/1024 causal activation bias (3/256 switches) vs 45/256 unwarranted arithmetic flips.
methodologies.final_disposition: Canonical methodology of the final research manuscript.

methodologies.name: Dual-Oracle Verification, Enumerated Rival-Policy Gate & Stratified Welch/Bounded Inference
methodologies.purpose: Verify private SCM enumerator against independent public-text parser, audit deterministic shortcut policies, and pair Welch-Satterthwaite t CI with Hoeffding-style bounded CI.
methodologies.mathematical_or_technical_foundation: SE = sqrt(sum_h s_h^2 / (64*16)), Welch df, plus distribution-free radius sqrt(2*log(40)/128) = +/-24.01 pp.
methodologies.problem_addressed: Guarantee prompt-to-key integrity, prove immunity to enumerated source-blind/target-blind shortcuts, and ensure valid interval coverage under discrete/bounded family scores.
methodologies.empirical_outcome_and_limitations: Passed 50/50 release verification checks; documented 12 literal constant-rival failures alongside 0 failures under constant-rivals-v1 clarification.
methodologies.final_disposition: Canonical statistical and audit framework of the final manuscript.
